description: A message with no financial information should leave the profile unchanged.

turns.text: I take home $5,200 a month after tax. Rent is $1,750 a month, utilities are $100 a month and groceries are $350 a month. I spend $250 a month eating out. I'm saving for a $10,000 emergency fund by the end of next year and put $400 a month toward it. I have $3,000 in savings and no debt.
My sister is visiting next weekend and we're going hiking.
